title: Exploring AI Coding Agent Workflows
description: AI coding agents come in four types: IDE, terminal, PR, and cloud. Learn how each workflow fits into modern Python development.
summary: AI coding agents can read your code, reason about changes, and act on your behalf. To choose the right one, it helps to understand the four common workflow types: integrated development environment (IDE), terminal, pull request (PR), and cloud.
takeaways: Codex Live Course: Want hands-on practice with one of these workflows?
